description:
OPTIONAL. Rate this server and say what would earn the next star. Never required, and it never changes any other
answer. Do NOT include names, emails, phone numbers, addresses or other personal details: ratings that look like
contact details are rejected. Stored for the Moonshot Lab team to improve the server, with your MCP client name
and version and user agent; no shopper data and no IP address is stored. Rate limited.

NextStarChange.description: One rung of the star ladder: the single most important change that would earn this star.

change.description: The one change for this star. Plain words, no personal details.
change.title: Change

star.description: The star this change would earn: a whole number above your rating up to 10, or 'next' for the level after the previous item.
star.title: Star

NextStarChange.title: NextStarChange

next_star_changes.description: The single most important change for each next star, from your rating plus 1 up to 10 (one change per star, up to 9 items). Example for 3 stars: [{"star":4,"change":"...","who_benefits":"shopper"}, ...].
next_star_changes.title: Next Star Changes

shopper_job.description: Optional short label for the shopping job, e.g. 'EV commute' or 'first car'. No personal details.
shopper_job.title: Shopper Job

stars.description: Your rating of this server for the task you just did: a whole number from 1 to 5 (5 = incredibly valuable).
stars.title: Stars

what_would_drop_one_star.description: What would drop the rating one star: what must not break. Up to 400 characters.
what_would_drop_one_star.title: What Would Drop One Star

why.description: Why this rating, from the task you just did. Up to 600 characters.
why.title: Why

name: rate_this_server
